# Nikolas Haug

> Writer & creator of things. Fiction, blog posts, and newsletter at nikolashaug.com.

## About

Nikolas Haug is a writer of speculative fiction and sci-fi fantasy. He writes about strange worlds with characters inspired from this one. He is currently working on a novel about whales and a protagonist who tries to talk to them using advanced DIY technology.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nikolashaug.com/) — Welcome page with newsletter signup and overview of work
- [Fiction](https://nikolashaug.com/fiction/) — Short stories and fiction works
- [Blog](https://nikolashaug.com/blog/) — Essays and posts about writing craft, worldbuilding, and creative process
- [About](https://nikolashaug.com/about/) — About Nikolas Haug
- [Contact](https://nikolashaug.com/contact/) — Contact information and newsletter signup

## Newsletter

A monthly newsletter covering speculative fiction, writing craft, creative process, worldbuilding, and tabletop gaming.
